reference.description: Nominal D405 640x360 color stream. Replace with measured D405 intrinsics if available.

notes: The server queries each D435i factory color intrinsic at 640x360 and computes its own crop.
A per-wrist actual_working_distance_mm overrides the global value when separate mount lengths are used.
Set rotate_180 independently after checking a saved frame from each wrist.
Measure lens-to-pinch distance along the camera-to-pinch ray; do not infer it from adapter thickness.
Do not enable robot motion until the transformed jaw-tip framing has been compared with the released D405 examples.
